description: Free AI models for council advisors — HF Inference API, OpenRouter free tier, Groq, Cerebras, local Ollama

model_landscape_april2026.gemma4_status: RELEASED Apr 2 2026. 4 sizes: E2B(2.3B), E4B(4.5B), 26B-A4B(MoE), 31B(dense). Apache 2.0. 256K ctx. NO free HF Inference Provider yet — weights only. Free via: Ollama (all sizes), OpenRouter (paid only at $0.14/$0.40 per 1M). HF model IDs: google/gemma-4-E2B-it, google/gemma-4-E4B-it, google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, google/gemma-4-31B-it
model_landscape_april2026.qwen36_status: Qwen3.6-Plus RELEASED Apr 2 2026. Proprietary cloud model (Alibaba Cloud). NO open weights. Available FREE on OpenRouter: qwen/qwen3.6-plus:free (1M ctx, 600 RPM). Previous note about HF model ID Qwen/Qwen3.6-Plus was WRONG — it is cloud-only.
model_landscape_april2026.qwen35_status: Qwen3.5 RELEASED Feb 16 2026. Open weights on HF. Sizes: 0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B, 27B, 122B-A10B, 397B-A17B. Model IDs: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B. Ollama: ollama pull qwen3.5
model_landscape_april2026.qwen3_status: Qwen3 (base series, 2025) open weights. Key: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen/Qwen3-4B, Qwen/Qwen3-8B. Available via HF Inference Provider (nebius/together). Groq free: qwen-qwq-32b (30K TPM, 1K RPD).
model_landscape_april2026.llama4_status: RELEASED March 2025. Scout: 17Bx16E (109B total), Maverick: 17Bx128E (~400B total). Open weights (gated). HF: meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct, meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct. FREE on Groq: llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct (30K TPM, 1K RPD). Ollama: ollama pull llama4:scout
model_landscape_april2026.mistral_small4_status: Mistral Small 4 (119B MoE, 256K ctx) RELEASED March 2026. HF: mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603. Apache 2.0. NOT on free HF Inference Provider yet. Previous models Mistral-Small-3.1-24B still available on HF.

hf_inference_api.description: HF Inference Providers — $0.10 free credits/month (free user), $2.00 (PRO $9/mo). Pay-as-you-go after. NOTE: As of Apr 2026, hf-inference provider focuses on CPU inference (BERT, GPT-2, small LLMs). Larger models route to external providers (Nebius, Together, Novita, etc.) and consume paid credits.
hf_inference_api.free_budget_note: Only $0.10/month free = ~10K tokens at typical rates. NOT suitable for heavy council use without PRO account.

council_strategy.recommended_stack: Use Cerebras (Qwen3-235B) as PRIMARY advisor — best quality, free, 1M tokens/day. Use Groq (Llama4-Scout) as FAST advisor — 30K TPM, 750 tps. Use OpenRouter (Qwen3.6-Plus:free) for LONG context (1M ctx window). Use HF (phi-4 / Mistral-Small-3.1) as FALLBACK.

daily_limits.groq_llama4: 1K requests/day = ~30M tokens if each is 30K tokens

corrections_vs_previous_config.qwen_36_plus_hf: WRONG. Qwen/Qwen3.6-Plus does NOT exist as HF open weights. It is a proprietary cloud model (Alibaba Cloud). Free access is via OpenRouter qwen/qwen3.6-plus:free only.
corrections_vs_previous_config.gemma_4_27b_it: WRONG. There is no google/gemma-4-27b-it. Correct sizes are: E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B, 31B. Use google/gemma-4-E4B-it or google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it.
corrections_vs_previous_config.gemma4_hf_inference: NOT available via HF Inference Providers as of Apr 4 2026. Weights-only download or use via local Ollama/transformers.
corrections_vs_previous_config.hf_free_credits: $0.10/month is nearly nothing. Don't rely on HF Inference API for council heavy use — use Groq or Cerebras instead.
